title: Agents expose writable profile names without profile controls
description:
All eleven current agents inherit visible writable PROFILE_NAME even though profile/config selection controls are hidden. Pure and mixed agent interface regressions reproduce unwanted definition, rename and persistence before the fix; non-agent controls pass. The requested repair defaults PROFILE_NAME hidden for any INDIGO_INTERFACE_AGENT at common attachment. Final unit4/4 and MCP30/30 pass natively and under scoped ASan/UBSan; independent unit4/4 and all-eleven-source review pass.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261105074950-dd62-hide-agent-profile-names-001.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
